## Testing Mode
RED

## What
Write a failing integration test in tests/scripts/test_bridge_inbound_integration.py (or test_bridge_inbound_field_coverage.py) verifying that write_create_events with a mocked Jira REST v3 ADF description dict produces a CREATE event with a non-None, non-empty 'description' field.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Test file: tests/scripts/test_bridge_inbound_field_coverage.py (or test_bridge_inbound_integration.py — check which file covers write_create_events)
- The test passes a Jira issue payload where fields.description is an ADF dict: {'type':'doc','version':1,'content':[{'type':'paragraph','content':[{'type':'text','text':'Hello from Jira'}]}]}
- After write_create_events executes, read the written CREATE event JSON and assert: event['data']['description'] is not None and 'Hello from Jira' in event['data']['description']
- Test must fail (RED) before implementation — currently jira_description = None because isinstance(adf_dict, str) is False
- Test name: test_write_create_events_adf_description_produces_text

## Files to Modify
- tests/scripts/test_bridge_inbound_field_coverage.py (preferred) or test_bridge_inbound_integration.py
